一个10岁的孩子可能不会写小说，但10岁的孩子知道他们的语言的结构，并且可以轻松地使用它。
By contrast, a model like GPT-3 was trained on 200 billion tokens.
与此相反，像GPT-3这样的模型使用了200亿个代币。
In other words, GPT-3 got exposure to the equivalent of 20,000 human years of text data.
换句话说，GPT-3接触到相当于2万年的文本数据。
Now it's true that GPT-3 can do a lot of things a 10-year-old can't do, like write a professional email, for example.

example. Think of the incredible power of a 10 year old's mind, the infinity of sentences it can understand and produce, the world it can create, the fantastical places it can go that no human has ever gone before.

And all of this is achieved with a tiny fraction of the data and the resources that it would take for an AI model to even begin to use language fluently.
而这一切都是用微小的数据完成的，一个人工智能模型开始流利地使用语言所需的资源。
So even if AI models are surprisingly good at learning complicated structures through associations, humans seem to be getting more from less.
即使人工智能模型能够通过协会学习复杂结构，人类似乎从少中得到更多。
So AI is giving us an unprecedented tool and opportunity for studying what makes us uniquely human.
因此，人工智能给我们提供了一个前所未有的工具和机会来研究使我们独特的人类的东西。
And now that AI is embedded everywhere in a oracle or black box.
现在，人工智能被嵌入到任何地方，在神器或黑盒中。
Instead, the next time you interact with AI, whether it's a chat bot or an assistant, try asking yourself, what about the model's behavior feels like human intelligence?
